name: SD: Make-to-order factory (generated by a system dynamics model)
description: A make-to-order factory's daily floor report: the customer orders backlog, raw material on hand, work in progress, units waiting for inspection, units in rework, finished goods waiting to ship, and shipping cartons on hand. Every unit packed goes into a carton (a co-flow) and the supplier tops the cartons up, so when production surges the cartons run low and packing waits. The data is generated by a system dynamics model of the factory (the ground truth is in sd-manufacturing/truth.model.json, including a stock the report does not show), so discovery can be checked exactly. Import history or Start, then Discover flows.
